headline: Government forces (Giants Brigades, Nation Shield Forces) launch fresh offensive near Bab al-Mandeb Strait
dek: Fierce fighting near Bab al-Mandeb as government forces advanced from several directions to seize Ansar Allah-held positions overlooking strait approaches; minefields and fiber-optic FPV 'Shawaz' drones used by Ansar Allah; casualties both sides, no confirmed territorial gains. Separately the Saudi-led…
sources: Xinhua News Agency reporting, quoting an anonymous Yemeni government military official
fault_line: Is Bab al-Mandeb about to become the next shipping chokepoint flashpoint — and who pays the price first?

sections.what_happened: Fierce fighting near Bab al-Mandeb as government forces advanced from several directions to seize Ansar Allah-held positions overlooking strait approaches; minefields and fiber-optic FPV 'Shawaz' drones used by Ansar Allah; casualties both sides, no confirmed territorial gains. Separately the Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted 4 drones over Riyadh/Saudi regions and destroyed 2 ballistic-missile launchers in Saada on Saturday.
sections.what_verified: Six+ outlets carry near-identical copy; strait geography and forces' identities consistent. No independent/Ansar Allah-side confirmation surfaced in this check.
sections.what_disputed: Anonymous single source; no territorial gains confirmed; no Ansar Allah statement located; Xinhua is the only wire origin. No verified shipping disruption.
sections.why_matters: Yemen/Red Sea is Tier-1 audience demand; frame as attributed report with map of the strait. Emphasize no verified shipping disruption yet — monitor against the chokepoint trigger.
